# Exit codes

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_exit_codes.py. -->

| Code | Category | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | `success` | Operation completed or verification ready |
| 1 | `blocked` | Acceptance not met or required case absent |
| 2 | `usage` | CLI parsing or usage error |
| 3 | `configuration` | Invalid input, configuration or missing approval |
| 4 | `unavailable` | Execution environment unavailable |
| 5 | `integrity` | Evidence replay or current-source gate failed |
| 130 | `interrupted` | Interrupted by the caller |
